import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

from harbichess.training.history_openings import file_hash


def main():
    root = Path('/workspace/HarbiChess')
    work = Path('/workspace/work/harbichess')
    source = work / 'broad-history-v4-pinned'
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=source, text=True) == ''
    source_commit = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=source, text=True).strip()
    book = root / 'docs/research/UFUK-broad-history-opening-splits-20261004.json'
    protocol = root / 'docs/runs/UFUK-broad-history-v4-preregistration-20261004.md'
    audit = json.loads((root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-history-input-20261004/root-integrity-audit.json').read_text())
    assert audit['status'] == 'pass' and audit['roots'] == 5120 and audit['book_sha256'] == file_hash(book)
    output = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-history-v4-data-20261004'
    controller = root / 'artifacts/ufuk-broad-v4-collection-controller-20261004'
    controller.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    profile = {'schema': 1, 'source_commit': source_commit, 'book_sha256': file_hash(book), 'protocol_sha256': file_hash(protocol), 'weights_sha256': file_hash(root / 'artifacts/ufuk-all-train-20261003/checkpoints/step-009250/model.safetensors'), 'stockfish_sha256': file_hash(work / 'stockfish/stockfish-linux-x86-64-universal'), 'controller_sha256': file_hash(Path(__file__)), 'whole_stage_wall_seconds': 10800, 'workers': 4, 'continuation_plies': 32, 'games_per_family': 4, 'seed': 20261025, 'memory_stop_bytes': 15 * 1024 ** 3, 'disk_min_free_bytes': 8 * 1024 ** 3}
    assert profile['source_commit'] == '8fa4f2907d1a661ef30e995ee025ceaeb1c1a0df'
    assert profile['weights_sha256'] == '18f2aae5a4dca317229b87af17ee393a4e786db3369e54aaf32c926a811cb5ae'
    assert profile['stockfish_sha256'] == '0f83d24cc46d2c66c60f16001af5444873bc112b7d028594513426894c12da19'
    assert Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max').read_text().strip() == '400000 100000'
    assert int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text()) == 16 * 1024 ** 3
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'f417a45:docs/runs/UFUK-broad-history-v4-preregistration-20261004.md'], cwd=root) == protocol.read_bytes()
    verifier_path = work / 'verify-ufuk-broad-v4-first-root.py'
    profile['first_root_verifier_sha256'] = file_hash(verifier_path)
    budget_path = controller / 'stage-budget.json'
    if budget_path.exists():
        budget = json.loads(budget_path.read_text())
        assert budget['profile'] == profile
    else:
        budget = {'profile': profile, 'first_start_epoch': json.loads((root/'artifacts/ufuk-broad-collection-controller-20261004/stage-budget.json').read_text())['first_start_epoch'], 'scope': 'Single fixed stage10800whole elapsed seconds, including interruptions/idle; no fresh wall budget on resume. Complete game files only resume boundary; no paid resources.'}
        with budget_path.open('x') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(budget, indent=2) + '\n')
    remaining = 10800 - (time.time() - budget['first_start_epoch'])
    assert remaining > 30, 'Registered remaining stage budget exhausted; no extension'
    invocation = len(list(controller.glob('invocation-*-command.json')))
    stdout_path = controller / f'invocation-{invocation:02d}.stdout.log'
    stderr_path = controller / f'invocation-{invocation:02d}.stderr.log'
    assert not stdout_path.exists() and not stderr_path.exists()
    command = [sys.executable, '-m', 'harbichess.training.oracle_data', str(output), '--openings', str(book), '--weights', str(root / 'artifacts/ufuk-all-train-20261003/checkpoints/step-009250/model.safetensors'), '--stockfish', str(work / 'stockfish/stockfish-linux-x86-64-universal'), '--wall-seconds', str(remaining - 15), '--games-per-family', '4', '--workers', '4', '--seed', '20261025', '--balanced', '--continuation-plies', '32']
    receipt = {'command': command, 'cwd': str(source), 'PYTHONPATH': str(source / 'src'), 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'stage_budget': budget, 'remaining_seconds_at_start': remaining, 'started_epoch': time.time(), 'stdout': str(stdout_path.relative_to(root)), 'stderr': str(stderr_path.relative_to(root))}
    command_path = controller / f'invocation-{invocation:02d}-command.json'
    with command_path.open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'starting': 'controlled broad teacher collection', 'source_commit': source_commit, 'remaining_whole_seconds': remaining, 'families': 5120, 'planned_trajectories': 20480, 'labelled_rows_maximum_not_assumed': 655360}), flush=True)
    failure = None
    first_root_checked = (controller/'first-root-preflight.json').exists()
    with stdout_path.open('x') as stdout, stderr_path.open('x') as stderr:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONPATH': str(source / 'src'), 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1'}, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, start_new_session=True)
        while process.poll() is None:
            elapsed = time.time() - budget['first_start_epoch']
            free = shutil.disk_usage(root).free
            memory = int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current').read_text())
            if elapsed >= 10800:
                failure = 'registered whole stage wall exhausted; no extension'
            elif free < profile['disk_min_free_bytes']:
                failure = 'registered disk free guard<8GiB'
            elif memory > profile['memory_stop_bytes']:
                failure = 'memory guard>15GiB on16GiB host'
            elif output.exists() and any(output.glob('*.failure.json')):
                failure = 'invalid teacher/reference query; retain failure packets and complete games'
            if failure:
                try:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                break
            if not first_root_checked and all((output/f'train-000-{i}.json.gz').exists() for i in range(4)):
                try:
                    import runpy
                    preflight = runpy.run_path(str(verifier_path))['verify'](output, book)
                    with (controller/'first-root-preflight.json').open('x') as preflight_stream:
                        preflight_stream.write(json.dumps(preflight, indent=2)+'\n')
                    first_root_checked = True
                    print(json.dumps({'first_root_actual_preflight':'pass','opposite_neural_colours':True}),flush=True)
                except Exception as error:
                    failure = 'actual first-root control/history/target preflight failed: '+repr(error)
                    continue
            state = {'status': 'running', 'elapsed_whole_stage_seconds': elapsed, 'remaining_whole_stage_seconds': max(0, 10800 - elapsed), 'memory_current_bytes_including_file_cache': memory, 'disk_free_bytes': free, 'generation_pid': process.pid}
            (controller / 'progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2) + '\n')
            time.sleep(2)
    receipt.update(returncode=process.returncode, failure=failure, finished_epoch=time.time(), elapsed_whole_stage_seconds=time.time() - budget['first_start_epoch'])
    if not failure and process.returncode == 0:
        dataset = json.loads((output / 'dataset.json').read_text())
        complete = first_root_checked and dataset['status'] == 'completed' and dataset['games'] == 20480 and dataset['rows'] >= 400000
        status = 'completed-awaiting-independent-audit' if complete else 'failed-coverage'
        receipt['dataset'] = dataset
    else:
        status = 'failed' if failure else 'incomplete'
    result = {'status': status, 'receipt': receipt, 'scope': 'Collection only; no optimizer updates/model promotion/strength/self-learning claim. Independent everyrow/hash/history audit and new training preregistration required.'}
    with (controller / f'invocation-{invocation:02d}-result.json').open('x') as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    (controller / 'progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status': status, 'elapsed_whole_stage_seconds': receipt['elapsed_whole_stage_seconds'], 'returncode': process.returncode, 'failure': failure}, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'finished': status, 'returncode': process.returncode, 'failure': failure, 'elapsed_whole_stage_seconds': receipt['elapsed_whole_stage_seconds']}), flush=True)
    if status != 'completed-awaiting-independent-audit':
        raise SystemExit(2)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import json
from pathlib import Path

from harbichess.training.history_openings import file_hash
from harbichess.training.oracle_data import read_game, validate_row


def verify(directory: Path, book_path: Path) -> dict:
    paths = [directory / f'train-000-{i}.json.gz' for i in range(4)]
    games = [read_game(path) for path in paths]
    opening = json.loads(book_path.read_text())['splits']['train'][0]['opening']['moves']
    assert [g['job']['actor'] for g in games] == ['engine-engine', 'engine-engine', 'neural-engine', 'neural-engine']
    assert games[2]['job']['neural_color'] is True and games[3]['job']['neural_color'] is False
    assert len({g['job']['seed'] for g in games}) == 4
    for index, game in enumerate(games):
        job = game['job']
        assert job['family'] == 0 and job['game'] == index and job['split'] == 'train'
        assert job['opening'] == opening and job['max_plies'] == len(opening) + 32
        assert game['queries'] == len(game['rows']) > 0
        assert len(game['final_moves']) <= len(opening) + 32
        for row in game['rows']:
            board = validate_row(row)
            assert row['moves'][:len(opening)] == opening
            assert row['position_key'] == ' '.join(board.fen().split()[:4])
            assert row['wdl'] == row['references'][0]['wdl']
            assert len(row['references']) == min(4, board.legal_moves.count())
            assert all(ref['budget_nodes'] == 32768 and ref['actual_query_nodes'] > 0 for ref in row['references'])
    return {'status': 'pass', 'scope': 'Actual first complete root4games from planned nativeSF19corpus, no extra query budget. True full histories/legal native softWDL/actions/stops and opposite student colours verified before rest of collection accepted.', 'book_sha256': file_hash(book_path), 'files': [{'path': str(path), 'sha256': file_hash(path), 'rows': len(game['rows']), 'actor': game['job']['actor'], 'neural_color': game['job']['neural_color'], 'actual_nodes': game['actual_nodes'], 'termination': game['termination']} for path, game in zip(paths, games, strict=True)]}
